name: caretaker_forks_for_what_the_team_lacks
description: The caretaker plays any Builder (design 6.7): it works down the Builder's plan and takes a patching fork only while nobody on the team covers that check. A lone caretaken Lamplighter forks Skyward Lofts, a Rime Spire and an Iron Mortar; beside a Lookout (who covers Armored and Winged) the same plan deepens instead, and the Lookout, beside her, skips her Kestrel Flocks and Pinning Ballista. Two caretaken Lamplighters both play the whole plan, the second on the plan's alternative cells.

steps.msg: alone, the Lamplighter patches the sky and armour

steps.assert: duo[0].has('longbow_loft') and duo[0].has('great_cannon') and not (duo[0].has('skyward_loft') or duo[0].has('rime_spire') or duo[0].has('iron_mortar'))
steps.msg: beside the Lookout she deepens instead

steps.assert: duo[1].has('falcon_roost') and duo[1].has('siege_perch') and not (duo[1].has('kestrel_flock') or duo[1].has('pinning_ballista'))
steps.msg: and the Lookout beside her deepens too
each on her own plan's cells

steps.assert: scene.tower_at(8, 11).owner == 1 and scene.tower_at(7, 11).owner == 2 and scene.tower_at(11, 11).owner == 1 and scene.tower_at(11, 12).owner == 2
steps.msg: two Lamplighters: the second takes the alternative cells
and both play the plan, forking for the sky the team lacks
